start: Owner at branch A of a gym with 2 branches, online, Visits page on today

steps.action: In the card "Member from another branch" type the member's number in "Their mobile number" and tap "Find"
user_sees: "Looking…"
"<First name> is a member of <branch B>. Their plan covers every branch." and a "Check in" button
must_not: The member's full name, mobile or payments shown
Members of another business's gym found

user_sees: A toast "<First name> (<branch B>) checked in."
The box is cleared
must_not: Two check-ins from a fast double tap
The visit counted as a member of branch A

user_sees: A row with the time (IST), the first name, a "<branch B>" pill and "Undo"
must_not: The row missing after the toast

start: Owner at branch A; the member already checked in today, once at the desk and once from the member app

user_sees: "<First name> (<branch B>) is already checked in today." and no "Check in" button
must_not: A second check-in offered

user_sees: The member's row with an "App" pill when they checked in from the app
must_not: The app check-in missing from the list

start: Owner in the card "Member from another branch"

user_sees: Red banner "Type their 10-digit mobile number, like 98290 12345."
must_not: A lookup sent to the server

steps.action: Type a number nobody at the other branches has
user_sees: "No member of your other branches has this number."
must_not: A member of this branch shown as a visitor

steps.action: Find a member whose plan is for branch B only
user_sees: "<First name> is a member of <branch B>. Their plan is for that branch only. Ask them to go there, or ask the owner." and no button
must_not: A "Check in" button

steps.action: Find a member with no plan running today
user_sees: "<First name> (<branch B>) has no plan running today. Ask them to renew at the desk."
must_not: The words say renew while the check-in is still offered without a warning (see checkpoint)

steps.action: Look up a 31st number in one hour
user_sees: "This desk looked up 30 numbers of other branches in the last hour. Wait a little, then try again."
must_not: The lookup carries on

start: Owner checked in a member of branch B by mistake

user_sees: A toast "Check-in removed for <First name>."; the row goes
must_not: The member's branch still counting the visit

user_sees: The row back, with the new time
must_not: "already checked in" after the undo

user_sees: "From other branches today" empty
must_not: Yesterday's visitors listed as today's
